title: Explosive atmospheres
scope: Series covering hazardous area classification (part 10), equipment protection concepts and EPLs (parts 0, 1, 7, 14, 18), and inspection/maintenance of Ex installations.

title: Power transformers
scope: Series on power transformer ratings, cooling designations (ONAN/ONAF/OFAF/ODAF), tolerance and test methods.

title: Rotating machines — efficiency classes of line operated AC motors (IE code)
scope: Defines international efficiency classes IE1-IE5 for line-operated AC motors, the basis for most motor efficiency regulation.

title: Power cables with extruded insulation (1-30 kV)
scope: Construction, ratings and test requirements for extruded-insulation power cables from 1 kV up to 30 kV (XLPE, EPR).

title: Tests on electric cables under fire conditions
scope: Flame-spread tests for bunched cables; referenced when selecting cable for routes where fire load matters.

title: Functional safety — SIS for the process industry sector
scope: Lifecycle standard for safety instrumented systems: hazard and risk assessment, SIL determination, design, verification and operation of SIFs.

title: Functional safety of E/E/PE safety-related systems
scope: The generic functional-safety standard from which IEC 61511 is derived; defines SIL 1-4 and the reliability mathematics.

title: Communication networks and systems for power utility automation
scope: Substation communication, engineering configuration language (SCL), GOOSE peer-to-peer signalling between protection IEDs.

title: High-voltage switchgear and controlgear
scope: Series for HV/MV switchgear: part 200 covers AC metal-enclosed switchgear above 1 kV up to and including 52 kV.

title: Uninterruptible power systems (UPS)
scope: UPS terminology, performance and test methods; part 3 classifies output dependency (e.g. VFI SS 111).

title: Protection against lightning
scope: Lightning protection system design: risk management, air terminals, down conductors, earthing and surge protection.

title: Centrifugal pumps for petroleum, petrochemical and natural gas industries
scope: Design, mechanical and performance requirements for centrifugal pumps in O&G service (ISO 13709 equivalent).

title: Axial and centrifugal compressors and expander-compressors
scope: Mechanical design and testing requirements for special-purpose axial, centrifugal and expander-compressor trains.

title: Reciprocating compressors for petroleum, chemical and gas industry services
scope: Requirements for general- and special-purpose reciprocating compressors, pulsation and vibration control.

title: Machinery protection systems
scope: Sensor and monitoring architecture (proximity probes, axial position, vibration) for protected trains; hardware-level standard.

title: Petroleum, petrochemical and natural gas industries — air-cooled heat exchangers
scope: Design, fabrication and testing of air-cooled heat exchangers for general refinery service.

title: Fireproofing practices in petroleum and petrochemical processing plants
scope: Guidance on selecting where structural fireproofing is applied and which systems qualify.

title: Management of hazards associated with process plant buildings (752) and portable buildings (753)
scope: Siting studies for occupied buildings: blast, toxic and fire hazard management, permanent and portable modules.

title: Welded tanks, low pressure (620) and atmospheric (650)
scope: Design and construction of welded storage tanks; 650 Appendix E covers seismic design of tanks.

title: Centrifugal pumps for petroleum, petrochemical and natural gas industries
scope: The ISO twin of API 610; identical scope under the ISO/TC 67 programme.

title: Petroleum and natural gas industries — fixed steel offshore structures
scope: Design, fabrication and installation of fixed steel jackets and topsides, including structural reliability and fatigue.

title: Petroleum and natural gas industries — floating offshore structures (semi-subs, spars, FPSOs)
scope: Design and analysis requirements for floating production systems, hull strength and stability.

title: Minimum design loads and associated criteria for buildings and other structures
scope: US loading standard: wind, snow, seismic and blast provisions referenced for onshore buildings and structures.

title: Design of steel structures
scope: European structural steel design rules used across process plants in Eurocode jurisdictions.

title: Process piping
scope: Design, materials, fabrication, testing and inspection of process piping — the reference piping code in most projects.

title: Standard for electrical safety in the workplace
scope: Arc-flash analysis, PPE categories and safe work practice requirements for electrical work.

title: Rapid rise fire tests of protection materials for structural steel
scope: The hydrocarbon fire curve test that epoxy intumescent and cementitious fireproofing must pass for process zones.
